summary: Validate calibration reports before ranking endpoint observations

delivery.outcome: Resolve issue138: validate bounded calibration reports before ranking and return typed errors for malformed or inconsistent sample data, through independent protected delivery.
nonGoals: No paid probes, new models, provenance/authority claims, runtime policy, credentials, deployment or release changes.

architecture.decision: Validate the existing report and sample metadata before dereferencing it. Preserve the fixed workload, snapshot/model freshness, distinct attempts, compatible endpoints, failed-provider exclusion and existing nonnegative numeric parser. Caller reports remain advisory, not authenticated execution evidence.
interfaceChanges: Invalid rank-calibration inputs consistently use the existing CompletionError contract.
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of report validation changes.

validation.evidence: Reproduced malformed reports, off-plan samples, invalid metrics/accounting, legitimate success/failure/dry-run reports and disproved negative-penalty/model claims; independent exact-head publication.
